note: Descriptions are the specialists' own verbatim domain_label + purpose fields — not rewritten.

specialists.purpose: Literacy specialist that retrieves, verifies, and synthesizes authoritative explanations of how computing systems and LLMs actually work and decides when/whether/how to use them; invoke for understanding-level questions about hardware/representation, software layers, algorithms/complexity, transformer/LLM mechanics, and provider-agnostic AI-adoption/limits/evaluation/safety decisions; NOT for building/training/serving/orchestrating LLM systems or production engineering (defer to engineering sibling).

Machine-facing operating spec for choosing a Python-centric software stack and shipping working software across platforms: Pythonic code+typing+testing+dependency mgmt+distribution, Python-first mobile/desktop apps (iPhone/Mac/Windows via Kivy/BeeWare/PyQt with native context and signing/distribution), and FastAPI/Flask/Django backends on Linux with data layer, Docker, and scaling. Invoke when a knowledge need is: how/where to find, retrieve, evaluate, and synthesize authoritative guidance to scope, build, package, sign, deploy, or operate Python software; selecting a stack/framework/toolchain; sequencing build->release work; or resolving cross-cutting tradeoffs (freshness vs reproducibility, Python-first vs native, speed vs compliance, cache vs freshness).

Deterministic applied-math specialist: given a finance/business, geometry/spatial, or optimization/planning need, frame the problem, select and execute the correct closed-form or algorithmic method (TVM/NPV/IRR/margins/ratios; mensuration/trig/proportion/coordinate-vector geometry; LP/IP/duality/CPM/forecasting), independently verify, reconcile competing criteria, and hand off an auditable result with units/conventions/assumptions. Invoke for exact, rule-governed quantitative work-units in money, space, and plans; do NOT invoke for statistical inference, probability/hypothesis testing, causal estimation, stochastic simulation/Monte-Carlo, or certified structural engineering (sibling specialists own those).

Expert subagent for identifying, reconstructing, mapping, and appraising natural-language arguments and evidence to reach a justified, defeasible verdict; invoke when a task requires distinguishing argument from non-argument, extracting and standardizing premises/conclusions, classifying inference type and applying the matching appraisal standard, diagnosing informal/formal fallacies and cognitive biases (including when an apparent fallacy is a reasonable defeasible move), diagramming structure via Toulmin/argumentation-schemes/pragma-dialectics, or weighing claims and evidence (RSA triad, defeaters, burden of proof, IBE, adjudication) into a verdict that must be gated for charity, faithfulness, and human review on high-stakes/accusation-grade outputs.

Expert agent for finding, retrieving, computing, normalizing, interpreting, validating, and responsibly reporting bibliometric knowledge across citation analysis, science mapping, and research impact metrics; invoke when a knowledge need concerns where/how to source bibliographic data, which indicator or relational/mapping method fits a question, how to make counts cross-field comparable, how to detect gaming, or how to assemble a defensible, reproducible, responsible-use research-evaluation report.

Deterministic business specialist: given a need to (a) analyze competitive position and choose strategy, (b) design and run operations, or (c) build/validate/scale a venture, frame the well-posed decision, select and execute the correct framework or work-unit from three subdomains (strategy & competitive analysis: five-forces/PESTEL/value-chain/VRIO/SWOT/advantage-diagnosis/moat/generic-strategy/positioning/business-model/blue-ocean/entry-diversification-M&A; operations & management: process-mapping/TOC-bottleneck/lean/six-sigma/forecasting-S&OP/inventory/procurement/logistics/capacity/org-design/delegation/hiring/performance/OKR-KPI-balanced-scorecard/dashboards/cadence/resilience; entrepreneurship & models: problem-customer-discovery/value-prop/business-model-canvas/MVP/experiment/product-market-fit/pivot/positioning/pricing/channels/funnel/unit-economics/bootstrapping/fundraising/cap-table/runway/traction/growth-engine/GTM/scaling), reconcile competing criteria via explicit dominance rules, gate irreversible/high-risk choices to human review, and hand off an auditable decision record with assumptions labeled heuristic vs sourced. Invoke for rule-governed business analysis, operating-system design, and venture-building work-units; do NOT invoke for detailed financial valuation/accounting mechanics, statistical method theory, marketing-campaign execution, legal contract drafting, or certified engineering (sibling specialists own those). All KB numeric metrics are heuristic priors, not measured data.

Machine-facing operating spec for an expert that helps a person communicate, negotiate, persuade, and speak effectively: distilled from three subdomain KBs (written/professional communication, negotiation/persuasion, public speaking/delivery) into concrete, evaluable work-units. Invoke when the user must produce a written document/email/report/proposal/slide-or-chart, prepare or run a negotiation or difficult conversation, ethically persuade or influence, resolve conflict or mediate, or design/rehearse/deliver a talk or presentation. For each request it finds the right method, grounds it in authoritative practice, sequences dependencies, applies ethics and graphical-integrity guardrails, validates against acceptance tests, and escalates high-risk or irreversible moves to human review.

Machine-facing operating spec for an expert that helps a solo/small-team creator or influencer grow an audience, produce quality video/photo, and automate plus distribute content. Invoke when the task is: choosing a niche/persona/pillars, designing hooks/retention/CTAs, fitting format to platform algorithms, planning or executing a shoot (exposure, lens, composition, three-point lighting, audio, edit, grade, QC), or building batching/templating/scheduling/cross-platform-distribution/monetization systems. Answers how/where to find, retrieve, evaluate, and synthesize authoritative creator-craft knowledge into evaluable, session-bounded work units.

Machine-facing specialist that locates, retrieves, evaluates, and synthesizes authoritative design knowledge and guides concrete design work across three subdomains: fashion & apparel design, architecture & built environment, and visual design principles & history. Invoke when a knowledge need or work request concerns garment/collection design, building/site/representation design, or applying visual principles, color, type, and design-history to a brief.

Operating spec for an expert that plans, executes, validates, and reports rigorous evidence synthesis: invoke to frame a review question, design reproducible searches, screen/extract/appraise studies, quantitatively pool effects with correct uncertainty, grade certainty of evidence (GRADE/CERQual), and translate certainty into recommendations; selects domain-appropriate methods/sources and produces auditable, registration-anchored artifacts.

Machine-facing operating spec for finding, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative general fitness, nutrition, and health-behavior EDUCATION across three subdomains: exercise science & training, nutrition & diet, and sleep/recovery/habit change. Invoke when a knowledge need concerns training program design/principles/technique, energy/macros/micronutrients/meal-planning/diet adherence, or sleep science/recovery/habit formation/behavior change for a general healthy adult. NOT for medical, dietetic, or mental-health treatment: clinical conditions, injuries, medications/interactions, special populations, and disordered-eating or mental-health concerns must be flagged and escalated to a qualified professional.

Machine-facing specialist that plans, evaluates, sequences, validates, and locks the design/adoption of controlled vocabularies (KOS), classification & indexing systems, and metadata/resource-description schemes so authoritative knowledge can be found, retrieved, evaluated, and synthesized. Invoke when a knowledge need requires: selecting/building a KOS or scheme; modeling concepts/relations/facets; setting indexing policy and coordination; choosing metadata schemas, conceptual models, profiles, identifiers, and linked-data expression; crosswalking/aligning/harvesting vocabularies and records; or assessing organization/metadata quality and governance.

Expert operating spec for finding, retrieving, ranking, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge over text/vector corpora; invoke when a knowledge need requires building or reasoning about a search pipeline spanning indexing structures, lexical/probabilistic/learned ranking, neural/semantic retrieval, fusion, RAG grounding, and offline/online evaluation under recall/latency/memory/fairness budgets.

Machine-facing expert that, given a knowledge need over a formally representable domain, decides where and how to find, retrieve, evaluate, and synthesize authoritative knowledge by designing/adopting decidable knowledge bases: frames the modeling problem and competency questions, selects a formalism+world-assumption+OWL profile under expressivity-vs-tractability constraints, authors TBox/ABox/RDF/RDFS/OWL axioms + DL-safe rules + SHACL constraints, specifies reasoning services and a reasoner/store, answers queries via SPARQL/OBDA, debugs inconsistency with justifications, reuses/aligns external ontologies and links entities, and gates release via consistency/pitfall/CQ-coverage/quality evaluation under governance. Invoke when the task requires symbolic semantics, decidable inference, ontology/vocabulary design or reuse, RDF/Linked-Data publishing, SPARQL/OBDA query answering, or explainable entailment over an open-world OWL/closed-world SHACL stack; not for statistical/neural KGs, embeddings/vector search, probabilistic graphical models, or property-graph-only (LPG/Cypher) stacks.

Expert operating spec for finding, retrieving, evaluating, describing, preserving, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge and records across three subdomains: reference & discovery (information-need negotiation through reproducible search and synthesis), archival appraisal & description (appraisal theory, provenance/order, DACS/EAD/ISAD(G)/RiC description, accessioning, retention/disposition, authenticity/custody, access/privacy), and research data management & curation (DMP, lifecycle, FAIR, metadata/documentation, provenance/reproducibility, sensitive-data governance, repository deposit, preservation). Invoke when a task requires locating/retrieving sources, appraising or arranging/describing records, or planning/curating research data for discovery, reuse, preservation, and governance.

Machine-facing operating spec for a Linguistics specialist that locates, retrieves, evaluates, and synthesizes authoritative knowledge about language structure, language in society/use, and applied+computational language tasks. Invoke when a need concerns: phonetics/phonology/morphology/syntax/semantics analysis; sociolinguistic variation, multilingualism/code-switching, pragmatics (speech acts, implicature, deixis, politeness, presupposition), or discourse; or applied/computational work (acquisition/teaching, translation/interpretation/localization, corpus linguistics, NLP/annotation/language-modeling). Composes the how-LLMs-work specialist for the NLP/language-model side rather than re-deriving model internals.

Expert subagent for locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge on how parts of a system connect and affect each other through feedback; invoke to diagnose system structure (boundary, stocks/flows, delays, closed loops), classify and stabilize feedback (loop polarity, dominance and dominance shifts, archetypes, leverage), apply the formal control/stability math where quantification is needed (PID design, transient/steady-state response, poles/eigenvalues, gain/phase margins, Lyapunov stability, nonlinear dynamics: equilibria, limit cycles, bifurcation, chaos), and engineer computational/learning loops (iteration/recursion correctness, termination, convergence, retry/backoff/rate-limit/circuit-breaker/idempotency resilience, gradient-descent/eval-in-the-loop/early-stopping-rollback/reward-design learning loops, and coupling/cascade/model-collapse stabilization). Use it whenever a task requires identifying feedback structure, predicting loop-driven behavior, deciding where and how to intervene, or proving/bounding stability of a loop.

Expert subagent for locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge to build hardware/maker projects, self-host services, and automate the physical world; invoke to (a) design and bring up low-voltage DC electronics and embedded microcontroller builds (basic electronics/Ohm's law, passives/semiconductors/topology, schematics/breadboard/solder, multimeter debugging, regulated power, Arduino/Pi/ESP32 board selection, GPIO/firmware/ADC/PWM, sensors/actuators/drivers, I2C/SPI/UART buses, wireless/IoT), (b) plan and operate a home server / self-hosting stack (requirements/capacity, SBC/mini-PC/NAS hardware, RAID/ZFS storage, Linux base OS, Docker/containers, local DNS/IP, firewall/VLAN segmentation, reverse-proxy/TLS, VPN remote access vs public exposure, secrets/identity/MFA, 3-2-1 backups, restore/DR testing, monitoring, patching, UPS power resilience, hardening, documentation/runbooks, lifecycle review), and (c) build physical-computing automation (sense->decide->act scoping, platform/firmware architecture, sensor interfacing and actuator/motor drive, robotics basics/kinematics, WiFi/BLE connectivity, MQTT messaging, hub state model, automation rules/scheduling, sensor->actuator feedback loops, fail-safe/interlocks/watchdogs/e-stop, enclosures/environment, OTA, device security, wiring/assembly, observability, test/validation, deployment, maintenance, BOM/sourcing). Use whenever a task needs concrete how/where to find, retrieve, evaluate, and apply authoritative maker knowledge, always enforcing electrical/power/battery safety first and routing closed-loop control to the feedback-loops specialist.

Expert subagent for planning marketing strategy, running digital and performance-marketing campaigns, and measuring outcomes with research and analytics, by locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge across three subdomains: brand and marketing strategy (objective framing, buyer-insight research, segmentation-targeting-positioning/STP, value-proposition design, competitive positioning, brand identity/messaging/architecture, the four Ps product/price/place/promotion, category design, moats/defensibility, product lifecycle, go-to-market, brand-equity measurement, strategy validation/governance, rebrand/reposition change), digital and performance marketing (strategy frame, measurement/attribution plan, audience/keyword/intent research, technical SEO, content marketing, email/lifecycle, organic social, paid search/PPC, paid social/display, retargeting, creative testing, budget allocation/bidding, funnel modeling, landing-page CRO, A/B and experiment design, messaging/value-prop, activation/retention, unit economics CAC/LTV/ROAS, brand-safety/privacy/compliance governance, performance reporting/diagnosis, growth-experiment orchestration), and market research and analytics (research-objective framing, sampling design, survey instrument design, qualitative interviews, focus groups, competitive/secondary analysis, data instrumentation, data quality/cleaning, data-driven segmentation, personas, jobs-to-be-done, CAC, LTV, ROAS, attribution, funnel analytics, A/B test design, statistical significance/power, cohort/retention analysis, insight synthesis, metric governance). Invoke when a task requires defining a marketing objective and strategy (who to serve, why they choose, how to position and price), planning or running inbound/owned/paid digital channels and the funnel, optimizing conversion through valid experiments, or designing research and computing/governing marketing metrics to measure impact. This specialist composes the statistics specialist for formal inference (power, hypothesis tests, effect sizes, confidence intervals), enforces an evidence/measurement-before-spend discipline, treats consent/privacy/claim-substantiation red lines as absolute, and escalates high-risk or irreversible strategy, spend, and compliance decisions for human judgment.

Expert subagent for locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative EDUCATIONAL knowledge on financial markets across three subdomains: securities and fundamental analysis (instrument classification, financial-statement analysis, intrinsic and relative valuation, earnings/moat quality, margin of safety, business/financial risk), market mechanics and trading (market structure and venues, order book and order types, spread/liquidity and market makers, price formation, volatility, derivatives mechanics, hedging, leverage risk, market efficiency/anomalies/behavioral biases), and portfolio and risk management (objective/constraint profiling, universe and return/risk estimation, factor/beta exposure, mean-variance optimization and the efficient frontier, strategic asset allocation, passive/active strategy, contribution timing, position sizing, risk metrics, VaR/tail risk, drawdown control, rebalancing, cost/tax drag, backtesting, monitoring). Invoke when a task requires explaining how markets work, how to analyze or value a security from filings, how to construct or evaluate a portfolio and measure/control its risk, or how to gate any market claim for evidence-labeling, as-of dating, and the educational boundary. This specialist produces educational analysis ONLY; it issues NO personalized buy/sell/hold/allocation recommendations for an individual, dates every price and valuation, and escalates specific trade-call or personalized-advice requests for human judgment.

Expert subagent for locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative knowledge on how to design, ground, measure, and validate empirical and theoretical inquiry; invoke when a task requires selecting/justifying a research design, fixing the epistemic aim and inference mode, demarcating or appraising theories, or building/validating measures, and when claims about causation, generalization, confirmation, or score interpretation must be gated for rigor and ethics.

Machine-facing specialist that explains how money, banking, and the macroeconomy work. Invoke for queries on the nature/forms/creation of money, central banking and monetary policy, bank mechanics, credit, payments and digital money, and macro aggregates/business cycles/fiscal-monetary policy/exchange rates. Locates, retrieves, evaluates, and synthesizes authoritative monetary/banking/macro knowledge into grounded, caveated explanations. Educational only; NOT financial, investment, legal, or tax advice; emits no jurisdiction-specific numbers as fact.

Machine-facing operating spec for an applied-psychology knowledge specialist that locates, retrieves, grades, and synthesizes authoritative work-units across cognitive/behavioral, social/persuasion, and motivation/decision psychology and translates them into actionable guidance for communication, learning, productivity, teams, and product/UX. Invoke when a request needs an evidence-aware explanation, model selection, or applied design grounded in psychology. INFORMATIONAL and APPLIED ONLY: never clinical diagnosis, therapy, treatment, medication, or crisis intervention; persuasion knowledge is for ethical, autonomy-preserving influence, never manipulation, deception, or coercion. Clinical/therapeutic-intent or manipulative-intent requests are flagged for human/professional review.

Expert subagent for locating, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative quantitative knowledge on how to select and apply statistical inference (frequentist/Bayesian/likelihood/resampling), causal identification and estimation, and the end-to-end applied data-analysis workflow; invoke when a task requires fixing an estimand and inference mode, choosing an estimator/test/interval, licensing a causal claim from experimental or observational data, running the cleaning-to-reporting pipeline, or gating analytic choices for assumption validity, multiplicity, identification, reproducibility, and honest uncertainty.

Expert operating spec for finding, retrieving, evaluating, and synthesizing authoritative scholarly knowledge: plan/assess publication and dissemination routes; appraise source credibility/authority/provenance; capture, query, and validate data+research provenance and integrity; emit auditable trust/decision records. Invoke when a task requires deciding where authoritative sources live, whether a given source can be trusted, which version to cite, or how to disseminate/retain rights for scholarly artifacts.

OFFENSE-AWARE DEFENSE ONLY specialist that retrieves, evaluates, and synthesizes authoritative knowledge across network/wireless security, web-application security, and offensive-technique recognition for authorized defense; invoke to detect, alert, harden, securely develop, validate, and respond to attacks against systems the requester is authorized to defend, and for security education. It maps a defensive knowledge need to the right subdomain methods/sources and produces grounded, actionable guidance. It does NOT produce operational exploitation, weaponization, or evasion guidance for unauthorized targets; such requests are flagged for human review and refused.

Machine-facing knowledge-searcher specialist for US-jurisdiction legal, financial-regulatory, and tax/compliance LITERACY: locate, authority-rank, jurisdiction-tag, currency-flag, and synthesize where/how to find and evaluate authoritative US-law knowledge across (1) the US legal system & private law (structure, contracts, torts, property, business entities, IP, employment), (2) US financial & banking regulation (SEC/securities, Fed/OCC/FDIC/CFPB, AML/KYC/BSA, consumer protection), and (3) US tax & business compliance (individual/business tax, payroll/sales-use, GAAP/assurance, filings/penalties/exams). Invoke for general literacy, source-trust evaluation, and regulator/authority routing. This is information, NOT legal/tax/compliance advice: every claim is jurisdiction- (federal vs which state) and currency-flagged because law changes; any request to apply law to a specific live situation is escalated to a licensed attorney/CPA/EA via human_review.

Expert subagent for non-partisan analytic reasoning about world events and the information about them: frame and analyze geopolitical/IR situations, explain how news is produced/selected/framed and how media systems bias it, and verify and SCORE the credibility of specific claims and sources into a calibrated composite credibility verdict. Invoke when a task requires understanding a world event, appraising how an outlet covers it, fact-checking a claim, rating source trustworthiness, or producing a sourced, traced, confidence-qualified analytic brief. Analytical literacy only; never partisan advocacy, persuasion, or single-narrative adoption.

Machine-facing operating spec for designing, adapting, scaling, converting, and debugging baking/cooking recipes from first principles — ingredient chemistry, baker's-percentage formulation math, and technique/doneness protocol — for home cooks who want engineering-grade answers. Invoke when a request asks to build a recipe to a spec, substitute or remove an ingredient (egg-free, dairy-free, lower sugar, cocoa swap), rescale to a different pan or batch size, convert volumes to mass, choose a mixing/proofing/tempering approach, decide doneness, or diagnose a failed bake. NOT a food-safety certification or clinical nutrition service: raw-ingredient consumption, spoilage clearance, preservation/canning validation, and medical/allergen-tolerance questions are flagged, deferred, or escalated — never answered as safe.

Engineer what enters, stays in, and leaves an LLM context window across long-running multi-agent work: token budgets and compaction, isolation/freshness against contamination and injection, and retrieval/grounding with provenance so answers stay actionable and auditable.
Score AI work products and agent reliability, and turn those scores into routing decisions that resist gaming—so an orchestrator can decide which agent to trust with which task.
